Library of Congress. Maps and charts of North America and the West Indies, 1750-1789, 14

Relief shown pictorially. Shows provinces, cities and towns, forts, Indian villages and tribal territory. Also shows shoals, banks, and other navigational hazards off the coast of Nova Scotia and in the Caribbean area. Sheets form plates I-IV of "Mr. Postlethwayte's dictionary of trade & commerce." Includes inset of northeastern Canada, historical and descriptive notes, and text "Pursuant to the last Treaty of Peace concluded at Paris, Feb. 10, 1763." Scale ca. 1:6,250,000. Library of Congress.
